description: The minimum defining p is attained, lies below every obstruction size, and every smaller strong-finite-intersection family has a pseudointersection.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SmallFamilies.pseudointersectionNumber_spec :
  (∃ F,
      Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SmallFamilies.IsPseudointersectionObstruction F ∧
        Cardinal.mk ↑F = Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SmallFamilies.pseudointersectionNumber) ∧
    (∀ (F : Set (Set ℕ)),
        Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SmallFamilies.IsPseudointersectionObstruction F →
          Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SmallFamilies.pseudointersectionNumber ≤ Cardinal.mk ↑F) ∧
      ∀ (F : Set (Set ℕ)),
        Cardinal.mk ↑F < Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SmallFamilies.pseudointersectionNumber →
          Lemmatheca.SetTheory.FiniteErrors.HasStrongFiniteIntersectionProperty F →
            ∃ P, Lemmatheca.SetTheory.FiniteErrors.IsPseudointersection F P
